profiles.name: Elizabeth Holmes
profiles.role: Theranos founder and chief executive; central subject of the film
profiles.background: The SEC's 2018 announcement identifies Holmes as Theranos's founder and CEO. Her corporate role makes dated representations about the company's technology and business relevant to this investigation.
profiles.involvement: The festival synopsis describes documentary access before her incarceration. A later account of a past capability must be compared with evidence available at the earlier date, not treated as a substitute for it.
profiles.connection: Led the company in which Balwani held senior operational roles. The later domestic setting with Billy Evans is a different relationship and period.
profiles.analysis: Test specific statements, knowledge and dates. Neither a sympathetic portrayal nor an uncomfortable interview overturns a legal finding. The DOJ reported four investor-related convictions in January 2022, alongside acquittals and counts without a verdict.
profiles.gap: A checked film transcript, dated technical responsibilities and a statement-by-statement comparison remain incomplete. Visible nodding cannot establish dishonesty or a diagnosis.

profiles.name: Ramesh ‘Sunny’ Balwani
profiles.role: Former Theranos president and chief operating officer; separately tried defendant
profiles.background: The DOJ describes Balwani as a senior Theranos executive. Its July 2022 announcement reports two conspiracy convictions and ten wire-fraud convictions involving investors and patients.
profiles.involvement: His operational role belongs to the company history under examination. That does not establish which film sequences discuss him; a checked scene record is still needed.
profiles.connection: Executive colleague of Holmes. His verdict came from a separate trial and must not be substituted for hers, or hers for his.
profiles.analysis: Investigate responsibility through dated organisational roles, communications and specific decisions. A general label such as partner is too imprecise to allocate responsibility.
profiles.gap: A complete relationship chronology, disputed accounts and operational decision map have not been assembled here. The conviction announcement is not the full trial or later appellate record.

profiles.name: William ‘Billy’ Evans
profiles.role: Holmes's romantic partner in the festival's account of the film
profiles.background: The festival listing identifies Evans in the domestic setting. This provides a limited, attributed starting point—not a verified biography or technical credential.
profiles.involvement: His presence can give viewers access to Holmes's later private life. Assess what he actually says and what period it concerns before drawing a business connection.
profiles.connection: A later personal relationship with Holmes does not establish a role in earlier Theranos fundraising, laboratory operations or representations.
profiles.analysis: Domestic testimony may illuminate personal experience while leaving technical or financial questions unanswered. Those are different subjects, not inherently contradictory accounts.
profiles.gap: Independent background checks, exact scene statements and any documented business involvement remain research questions. No wrongdoing is inferred from the relationship.

profiles.name: Nathan Fielder
profiles.role: Co-director; the interviewer identified in this research
profiles.background: The festival credits Fielder alongside Lance Oppenheim. An indexed HBO publicity listing associates him with Nathan For You and The Rehearsal; direct access to that publicity page was blocked during this pass.
profiles.involvement: The participant interview discusses the film and performance. Credits establish an authored filmmaking role, not merely a neutral questioner placed in front of a camera.
profiles.connection: Works with Oppenheim on the film and with performer Amanda Seyfried in its production context. Professional collaboration does not establish a shared view of every disputed claim.
profiles.analysis: His earlier work is a reason to examine staging, awkward pauses, constructed situations and uncertainty about sincerity. That is a viewing hypothesis, not proof that a particular scene is staged or that his intention was to deceive.
profiles.gap: Why he was selected, who approached whom, editorial control and the exact interview protocol require direct production accounts. We cannot infer a commissioning motive from his reputation as a comedian.

profiles.name: Lance Oppenheim
profiles.background: The festival listing credits Oppenheim as a director alongside Fielder. A fuller career profile needs additional inspected sources.
profiles.involvement: Include him when examining access, selection, editing and the film's framing. The interviewer is not necessarily the sole author of what an audience sees.
profiles.connection: Shares the directing credit with Fielder; the division of practical and editorial responsibility is not established by the credit alone.
profiles.analysis: Ask how an account was constructed: which questions, recordings and counterevidence were retained, omitted or placed next to one another. Conclusions about intention need production evidence.
profiles.gap: A sourced background chronology, production decisions and allocation of final-cut authority remain unverified here.

profiles.name: Amanda Seyfried
profiles.role: Actor involved in the film's performance element
profiles.background: The participant interview identifies Seyfried's involvement and discusses performance. It is an edited participant account, not a complete verification of what every shot depicts.
profiles.involvement: A performed passage can explore or reconstruct an account. It is not itself a contemporaneous recording of Holmes saying those words.
profiles.connection: Collaborates within the film's production. Playing or interpreting a person does not make the performer a witness to the earlier business events.
profiles.analysis: For each passage distinguish voice, visible performer, script source, reconstruction notice and any documentary insert. Similar appearance or delivery is not a reliable identification method.
profiles.gap: The exact boundaries between recording and performance, source script and scene timestamps still need a checked film copy or authenticated transcript.

representations.label: Surviving investor presentation
representations.when: Exhibit version; delivery date to an individual investor not established here
representations.wording: runs comprehensive blood tests from a finger-stick
representations.wording_type: Short excerpt: Trial Exhibit 3696, PDF page 3
representations.reading: The verb runs presents a capability. The excerpt is not expressly framed as a future research objective.
representations.test: Identify device version, test menu, sample volume, off-device work, accuracy and qualifications accompanying this version.
representations.limit: The slide alone proves neither capability nor that a particular investor received it. It does not establish every oral qualification or an individual's knowledge and intent.

representations.label: Contemporaneous representation versus alleged operation
representations.when: 14 March 2018 enforcement announcement, describing earlier conduct
representations.wording: The SEC alleged a mismatch between represented proprietary capability and the use of third-party analyzers for most patient testing.
representations.wording_type: Editorial paraphrase of civil allegations; not a quotation
representations.reading: The material question is what the represented service could actually deliver at the investment date, not whether the general research ambition was worthwhile.
representations.test: Match an individual representation to dated demonstrations, validation, internal limitations and investor communications.
representations.limit: Civil allegations and settlement terms are not criminal findings. The DOJ's later account and count-by-count verdict must be read separately.

representations.label: Later platform account
representations.when: 2016 company technology announcement; later film discussion needs timestamps
representations.wording: A proposed integrated platform is a different claim from validated earlier delivery of a full testing service.
representations.wording_type: Editorial distinction; not a quotation from the film or company
representations.reading: A later architecture or development plan cannot retrospectively validate a prior product or investor representation. Conversely, failure of a prior product does not prove every later proposal scientifically impossible.
representations.test: Separate prototype operation, assay-specific validation, clinical use, menu breadth and commercial reliability for each date and version.
representations.limit: The company announcement is not independent performance evidence. The film's exact wording and surrounding question remain unverified.

finances.label: Capital raised
finances.status: Reported in a civil enforcement announcement
finances.account: The SEC said Theranos raised more than $700 million from investors through the alleged fraud. This is a fundraising statement, not a reconstruction of the company's total lifetime receipts or expenditure.
finances.needed: Dated cash receipts, investment instruments, opening and closing cash, and reconciliation to the precise period and scope of the figure.

finances.label: Revenue forecasts and actual revenue
finances.account: The SEC announcement alleges misleading business and revenue representations. Revenue is income from customers; investment receipts and share valuation belong in different categories.
finances.needed: Exact forecast version and date, supporting assumptions, period-matched recognised revenue and the records available to the investor at the time.

finances.label: Actual expenditure
finances.account: No verified allocation between payroll, research, premises, equipment, retail operations, advisers or litigation has been assembled. Those are investigation categories, not reported spending figures.
finances.needed: Period-matched general ledger, bank reconciliation, payroll summaries, supplier invoices, fixed-asset records and reliable public filings. Do not publish private account or employee details.

finances.label: What does failure mean?
finances.status: Editorial distinctions supported by different evidence types
finances.account: Scientific feasibility, assay performance, service reliability, business viability, honest fundraising and legal liability are separate questions. The DOJ reported investor-fraud convictions; a JCI service comparison examines a narrower testing question. Neither is a complete cash ledger.
finances.needed: Define the claimed failure before selecting evidence. A failed business is not by itself fraud; a fraud conviction does not settle whether every underlying scientific concept is impossible.
